description:
Sammy's friend from Tibidabo invited him to his birthday! Sammy wants to take a lot of stationery to draw a picture for his friend on the way. But for this he needs a special travel case!

So, guys, today Sue will help Sammy to take everything necessary to paint a picture while being on a trip! We are gonna make another organizer, but it's going to be quite unusual! This travel case for stationery will be as light as it could be. To make it we need a lot of craft foam and hot glue. Cut out parts of the case of different shapes and decorate some parts with paint. Then connect them with hot glue. To make our case open and close, we will place a zipper. The case has an external pocket for small items, and inside there are several compartments for art supplies, as well as wheels, and a handle on the outside. Everything is very convenient!

Our travel case is pretty much ready! You can get creative and decorate your organizer in any way possible! For example, we decorated it with a bright donut! Now Sammy can go on a new journey!
